development_selection: world-clustered win points first, bank margin only as tiebreaker
confirmation_selection: freeze one candidate before confirmation; matched V9 and candidate; positive world-bootstrap 95% lower bound of paired point gain; zero invalid games
selfplay_note: same V9 code in both seats provides a symmetric adaptive baseline; policy changes may alter both game paths
online_note: Kaggle rating is dynamic and cannot be inferred from local games
